visual_action: A montage of images and clips of Donald Trump. It begins with his face superimposed on a large tree. It then shows a full-body image of him superimposed next to a dandelion blowing in the wind. This is followed by a clip of him walking at night, then a clip of him sitting at a desk which dissolves into another image of him wearing a 'Make America Great Again' hat.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the sole subject of every visual in the video montage.

on_screen_text.text: since we’re doing the hunger games

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings, "I'm in the trees, I'm in the breeze, my footsteps on the ground. You'll see my face in every place, but you can't catch me now." The lyrics match the on-screen text.
audio_music: A soft, ethereal, and somewhat melancholic folk-style song with female vocals plays throughout the video, creating a haunting atmosphere. The song is identified as 'Full of love' by Arlot.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced montage with dissolves and superimposed images.
manipulation_or_satire: Cutout images of Donald Trump's head are superimposed onto a tree, and a full-body cutout of him is superimposed onto a nature scene with a dandelion. This is done to visually represent the lyrics about his inescapable presence.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a pervasive and inescapable presence, akin to a haunting figure from the dystopian world of 'The Hunger Games'.
intended_effect: To create a sense of unease and mockery towards Donald Trump by associating him with an eerie song and the dystopian themes of 'The Hunger Games'.
